# Segmented control

Radio-group segment selector with selected and unselected states; keyboard navigable without JavaScript.

Category: forms · Behavior: css-only · Schema: 1.0.0 · Source: original

## Variants

No variant table; the item has a single form.

Every color comes from a semantic role; nothing is hard-coded.

## Markup

```html
<!-- Radio-group semantics: native inputs, no JavaScript. Group name is yours to choose. -->
<div class="uifa-segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Range">
  <label class="uifa-segmented-option">
    <input type="radio" name="range" value="day" checked>
    <span data-uifa-slot="segment">Day</span>
  </label>
  <label class="uifa-segmented-option">
    <input type="radio" name="range" value="week">
    <span data-uifa-slot="segment">Week</span>
  </label>
  <label class="uifa-segmented-option">
    <input type="radio" name="range" value="month">
    <span data-uifa-slot="segment">Month</span>
  </label>
</div>
```

## Usage

Use for 2-5 mutually exclusive options. Native radios carry the state: selection and arrow-key navigation come free, no JavaScript. Give each group its own `name`; the visible segment is `[data-uifa-slot="segment"]`.
